messages.text: Give me a WSL command to find all the MD files from root down

To find all `.md` files from the root directory downward in WSL, use:

```bash
find / -type f -name "*.md" 2>/dev/null
```

The `2>/dev/null` suppresses permission-denied errors so you only see actual matches.

Run this in WSL:

```bash
sudo find / -type f -iname "*.md" 2>/dev/null
```

If that's too noisy (it scans Windows mounts too), try these narrower variants:

```bash
# Linux filesystem only, skip /mnt (Windows drives)
sudo find / -path /mnt -prune -o -type f -iname "*.md" -print 2>/dev/null

# Just your WSL home directory
find ~ -type f -iname "*.md"

# Windows user folders via WSL interop
find /mnt/c/Users -maxdepth 4 -type f -iname "*.md" 2>/dev/null
```
